label: GTC FINAL v3 baseline (all-Al radiator, no peak battery, full-peak BOL array)

supersedes.change: delete peak battery; extend solar wings for actual MPG40 BOL peak; scaled harness/PCDU, view-factor and ram-area propagation

status: v3 owner-approved direction, scratch engineering analysis; not published or vendor-qualified
authority: the author t602/t603: scoped baseline, 0 % weight reserve, 370/378.15 K caps waived for this concept
the author t605: spin1 items 1-3 (item 3 not rendered)
the author t612-t615: Al-only radiator study (GTC_FINAL_AL)
the author t619: ADOPT Al option (b) as the new final baseline
owner approved peak-battery deletion and BOL array growth, 2026-11-07 18:26 PT / 2026-11-08 10:26 Taipei
mass_reserve_policy: Minimum weight reserve 0 %; all unused mass under the 100 t launch budget is listed as RESERVE (kg/sc, t/launch, % of 100 t) (t615).

selected_additions.item1: NO peak battery; solar array enlarged for full peak at BOL; safe-mode battery 31.25 kg retained
selected_additions.item2: coolant swap water-proxy -> MPG40 (40 wt% PG) with NB2F2-port fin-root heaters (array-powered at sunrise), N2/EPDM insert, accumulator; pumps off in eclipse
selected_additions.item3: Whipple shields on the 4 central coolant trunks (SPF, bus side, no fin view)

open_items: radiator header MMOD protection (no simple bumper closes; architecture change needed)
EOL peak deficit (94% array retention); EOL growth informational only, not adopted
MPG40 peak inlet 403.4/404.1 K > Dow 393 K recommended max (pressurisation, glycol life)
6061 braze process for the integral/brazed fin-tube panel (narrow braze window; post-braze re-age) not designed
+13 % tube length per m2 (60 vs 68 mm pitch) raises tube MMOD exposure; not re-screened
launcher same-orbit performance, finite-hardware packing/CG, qualification
